## Purpose

What user or engineering problem does this change solve?

## Design-system impact

- [ ] No brand-anchor change
- [ ] Token/recipe change explained
- [ ] Any exception to Anti-AI-Slop is named and justified
- [ ] No new visual or styling dependency without review

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Keyboard and visible focus checked
- [ ] Arabic RTL checked
- [ ] English LTR checked
- [ ] Narrow and wide responsive states checked
- [ ] Contrast and reduced motion checked where relevant

## Evidence and limitations

Link screenshots, recordings, test output, or measurements that actually exist. State what was not tested; do not claim unverified checks passed.
